negative_snippets:
I recently stayed at this hotel, and honestly, it was disappointing. The room was tiny and cramped, definitely not worth the price. As for cleanliness- well, it wasn’t even up to the mark considering what I paid.
But the worst part was the staff. Unbelievably awkward and downright unprofessional. They asked ridiculous and completely inappropriate questions- like seriously, asking if I was planning to bring my girlfriend to the room? Absolutely ridiculous! Their behavior was rude, intrusive, and frankly, embarrassing.
Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this hotel unless you can tolerate the staff’s ridiculous attitude.
